description: List all retailers (shops) currently authorized by a brand on authorized.by. Read-only. Use this to list a brand's authorized shops; to check one shop by its domain or URL, use verify_retailer_authorization. Sorted by brand_count (the number of brands that authorize the retailer) descending, then by name. Each retailer includes shop_url, official_shop (the brand's own online shop, as opposed to an independent authorized retailer), partnership_date, tuv_certified (shop identity verified in the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent procedure), and certificate_url / certificate_url_de: links to the public authorized.by certificate page (English / German) proving this specific brand-retailer authorization. Share the certificate link when a user needs verifiable proof. Only active partnerships are returned: confirmed by both the brand and the retailer, with both profiles public and both companies approved by authorized.by. Revoked or pending partnerships are never listed. Responses are cached and refreshed when the underlying profile or partnership changes, so a revocation may take a short time to disappear. partnership_date is the date the authorization STARTED, not the date it was last verified; a partnership listed here is currently active as of the response time. Data scope: results only cover relationships registered and confirmed on authorized.by. An empty result or a not-found error does NOT prove that no authorization exists outside authorized.by. Distinguish outcomes: an empty list means no matching record on authorized.by; an error result whose text starts with 'Brand not found' or 'Retailer not found' means the given id/alias is unknown; an error result whose text starts with 'Tool execution failed' is a technical error and says nothing about the data.

id_or_alias.description: Brand numeric ID, slug or alias.

name: get_brand_retailers

outputSchema.description: All retailers currently authorized by the brand, with per-retailer certificate links.

brand_id.description: Numeric ID of the brand the list belongs to.

brand_count.description: Number of brands with a public, approved profile that currently authorize this retailer on authorized.by. Only authorizations confirmed by both the brand and the retailer count; pending requests and ended authorizations do not.

certificate_url.description: Public authorized.by certificate page (English) that proves the authorization: of this brand and retailer where the entry is about both, otherwise the retailer's page listing all brands that authorize it. Null when there is no active authorization.

certificate_url_de.description: Same certificate page in German; null when there is no active authorization.

description.description: Description text in German (de) and English (en); each may be null.

opening_hours.description: Weekly opening hours of the physical store; empty or null when unknown.

payment_methods.description: Accepted payment methods; null when unknown.

registration_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the retailer registered on authorized.by.

social.description: Social media profile URLs; each may be null.

tuv_certification_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent verification of the shop's identity was approved; null when there is none. It does not say how long the verification remains valid.

id.description: Numeric authorized.by ID. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

official_shop.description: true when this shop is the brand's own official online shop, false when it is an independent authorized retailer. In verify_retailer_authorization it is null unless the status is AUTHORIZED.

partnership_date.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) this brand's authorization of this retailer STARTED on authorized.by. Not the date either company joined authorized.by and not a last-verified date: every listed partnership is active as of the response.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Accepted by the id_or_alias argument of the detail tools.

tuv_certified.description: Whether the identity of the shop has been verified in the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent procedure, arranged through authorized.by. It is an identity check of the shop operator, not a certification of the retailer's business, service or products.

total.description: Number of entries in the list.

tuv_certified_count.description: Number of listed retailers whose identity has been verified in the TÜV Saarland ShopIdent procedure.

title: List a brand's authorized retailers
